constraints.rule: Sách võ công phải đúng trường và chưa học
constraints.message: Sách này không đúng với trường bạn! / Chiêu này đã học!

constraints.rule: Cộng điểm kỹ năng cần đủ level của điểm tiếp theo (skill.level) và có điểm kỹ năng
constraints.message: Trình độ không đủ yêu cầu. / Bạn không đủ điểm.

constraints.rule: Đồ rơi thuộc người giết trong 20 s đầu, biến mất sau 30 s
VP nhiệm vụ 1/3 (heo rừng luôn rơi rìu); boss không rơi đồ thường; chênh lệch level > 7 không rơi; 10% yên, 10% vật phẩm, 5% trang bị trong khoảng ±7 level
Mỗi bước có NPC riêng (task.npcs[index+1]); -1 = thầy/cô của trường; NPC phải đứng trong khu hiện tại
Bước chưa port được cơ chế (status skip trong quests) có mục 'Bỏ qua: <bước>' ở NPC giao nhiệm vụ
Câu đố: trả lời đúng đủ 5 câu thì qua 5 bước; sai thì hỏi lại
Nhập học ở thầy/cô (cần NV tìm hiểu 3 trường); nhận vũ khí và sách của trường
MP tối đa không dưới 100 (giá trị Java cho nhân vật mới)
Python receives detached snapshots and proposes plans; C# owns gameplay, normal player permissions and save state. No external endpoint by default, model download or gameplay execution through Brain.

commands.title: Synthetic learning contracts
commands.notes: GPU, teacher imitation, actual C# inference parity, PPO source/version isolation, checkpoint restart, regression gates and incomplete spool lines; no game server or save access.

Teleport to the entrance of the current main quest map (objective or giver/report NPC map). Does not skip the current step. No fixed target or special-map destinations return an explanation; dead/catch/fishing state refused.
Dev terminal: advance current accepted quest by one existing progression transition. Final step: report to NPC or /skip. No auto-accept.

commands.name: Các lệnh khác (bán, vứt, nâng cấp, chat, bạn bè, nhóm...)
NPC_IS_* (trạng thái quái: lửa, băng, gió, trói, vô hiệu)
Hiệu ứng nhân vật thêm / xoá (sub -101 / -99)

config.title: RAG cho người chơi AI
config.detail: NSO Server Control: _ragEnabled, _qdrantUrl, _embedModel, _llmContextTokens. Cần Ollama (bge-m3) và Qdrant ở 127.0.0.1:6333.

config.title: AI movement intent budget
config.notes: NSO Server Control > AI Move Step Px: default60, range12..120, next Play. Intent distance and execution budget; normal character Speed still caps motion. Motion revision and moveStepPx fingerprint evaluation; both arms receive --move-step-px.

config.title: Item/NPC learning rewards
config.default: new use 0.2, new purchase 0.1, timely use 0.3, NPC discovery 0.1, useful NPC 0.3
config.notes: Each weight 0..5. HP <=50%, MP <=25%, useful-use cooldown 30 s, near-full bag <=2 free slots; configurable. Novelty is template/NPC-based and survives normal save/relogin; opening/cancelling/rejected actions do not yield useful-service reward.

config.title: Ground drops - all characters
config.notes: Applied before Play for every character; lifetime clamped above protection. AI preferences under AI players: loot radius/vertical limit/stall/retry and zone spread/check/cooldown/timeout/population gap. RL evaluator receives the same ground timings and includes them in the environment fingerprint.

config.title: Online RL
config.notes: uv-managed Tools/Learning/.venv; NsoLearning sibling of save folder. 60 FPS/30-second stability gate; human recording and long evaluation off; teacher probability/rewards configurable. Source rules retained as teacher/fallback.

config.title: Autonomous agents
config.detail: NSO Server Control > Autonomous agents (count, damage/HP %, decision throttle, review, LLM endpoint/model/timeout/backoff/temperature/json mode/local only); more in NsoServer.Ai.AgentConfig.

config.title: Player Log
config.where: NSO Server Control > Player log (enabled, outgoing, snapshot seconds 5, payload bytes 48, keep files 20)
config.notes: Logs/PlayerLog/player_<time>.log in the project folder: IN client actions, OUT server replies, LOG server trace, EVT events, STATE snapshots. Server/Net/PlayerLog.cs.

config.title: Share Opens Map
config.where: NSO Gamepad Input > Share Opens Map
config.notes: Share/Create/Select opens world map only while in gameplay; off restores configurable _create key code.

config.title: Popup command horizontal inset
config.where: NSO UI Layout > Bottom Buttons > Popup Side Inset
config.notes: Logical pixels relative to wide panel edges. -2 matches paintFrame outer border. Live; narrow rows unchanged.

config.title: F6 default-browser shortcut
config.desc: Open balance web uses the current WikiUrl/#dashboard and OS default browser. No saved setting; hint reports availability/errors. Compile-only verified.

config.title: Wiki sprite cache
config.desc: Read-only original assets, highest available zoom 4..1; portraits are static. Missing assets show fallback. Cache resets with wiki/Play lifecycle.

config.title: Character progression profiles
config.default: Empty profiles: native base, 100% growth, +0 per level
config.desc: game-balance.json v2: characterProgression[0|classed|classId][stat]={base?,growthPercent?,growthFlat?}. Per-class fields inherit shared classed values. Schema and formulas: docs/CHARACTER_PROGRESSION.md.

config.title: NSO Game Control / Smooth World Motion
config.notes: Render-only fractional world/camera/projectile placement. Smooth Effects also controls list scrolling and weather particles. Target Frame Rate now accepts 60-144; this is a requested cap, not guaranteed hardware throughput.

config.title: NSO Game Control / Instant Movement Stop
config.notes: Stops grounded manual movement on the last horizontal button release. Disable to restore original one-unit-per-tick inertia. Jump/fall, remote and destination movement are excluded.

config.title: GameWorld.LootRules via #settings
config.notes: game-rules.json in save folder, loaded in release too. Global/ordinary gates separately adjustable. Next loot event uses successful save.

config.title: NSO Game Control effect presentation
config.default: Smooth Effects=true; Mob Health Seconds=0.12; Menu Open Seconds=0.14
config.notes: Inspector runtime options; durations clamped to 0..0.5 s. Disabling smoothing restores snapped drawing. Minimum opening blocks selection until visible.

config.title: GameWorld.LootRules.OverlevelGap
config.notes: Active value editable at #settings, persisted in game-rules.json; default 10. PlayerItems.DropLevelGapLimit is only the detached-state fallback. Ordinary max gap 7 is separate.

config.desc: Disabled by default: no unsourced HP/MP gain. Positive values explicitly opt into the former offline addition; not a Workbench loot setting.
Five-second equipment recovery interval, also used by optional positive natural recovery. Keeping 5000 preserves Java equipment timing.
Bật website tra cứu khi chạy game (Editor / development build).
Cổng đầu tiên của website; bận thì thử 9 cổng kế tiếp.
Tự mở trình duyệt khi game chạy.
Thư mục lưu save trong persistentDataPath.
Thư mục dữ liệu tĩnh (tables.txt, Data) trong StreamingAssets.

config.title: TaskOrders tunables
config.detail: TaskOrders.LevelRequire, DayPerDay, BossPerDay, BeastItemPerDay, DayCountMin/Max, DayLevelRange, reward fields, ExcludedMaps.

config.title: PlayerItemUse tunables
config.detail: PhucNangYenMin/Max, GiayVunPerBook, LimitKyNangSo, LimitTiemNangSo, LimitPhongLoi, LimitBangHoa, KhaDiMaps.

config.title: PlayerLuong tunables
config.detail: TopUpCards, TopUpLuongPerVnd, XuPerLuong, YenPerLuong, ExchangeMin, ExchangeXuMax, BagItems/BagCells, NamLinhChiMs.

config.title: Fishing / coin limit tunables
config.detail: PlayerItemUse.FishWaitMs, FishItems, FishRates; PlayerLuong.XuMaxStep, XuMaxCap, XuMaxFeePerStep.

config.title: Runtime JSON and Python Brain
config.detail: Optional persistentDataPath/NsoConfig/runtime-config.json v1: JSON > captured Inspector > defaults; agents overrides after legacy mapping. Export context action never overwrites. agents.BrainEndpoint defaults 127.0.0.1:8797, BrainAutoStart=true. Setup: uv sync --project Tools/Brain --locked. Secrets only supported environment/.env provider keys. BrainSessionIdleSeconds defaults to 600; interrupted external sessions expire. Supported runtime preference setters take priority within the current session.

deviations.title: Bot báo vị trí theo nhịp client (250 ms)
deviations.detail: BotMovement đi từng khung hình cục bộ nhưng chỉ gửi PLAYER_MOVE mỗi 250 ms (Char.sendMove), khi dừng, khi chạm đất hoặc ngay trước hành động khác; đi trên mặt phẳng không lùi về tâm ô. Trước đây 24 gói/giây làm client người chơi thấy bot quay trái phải.

deviations.title: Rules bắt buộc mua bình trước khi đánh
deviations.detail: Log 36 giờ: mọi lần AI chết đều có shop, có trên 500 yên mà 0 bình HP. RulePlanner mua bình trước khi còn dưới MinPotionsToFight (3); không bình thì chỉ đánh quái tối đa hơn 1 cấp; hết bình mà có tiền thì rút lui ở 55% HP (NoPotionFleeHpPercent).

deviations.title: Tăng năng lực học RL
deviations.detail: trainer.py: mạng 256x256 (cũ 64x64), giữ 65 536 mẫu/miền, nhân bản rules 32 768 mẫu x 8 vòng, PPO n_steps 1024 / batch 256 / 10 epoch, train mỗi 20 giây, 4 luồng torch. Model 64 cũ được thay bằng model 256 mới học từ rules rồi đánh giá như thường; C# đọc kích thước lớp từ file.

deviations.title: Trí nhớ dài hạn RAG (Qdrant)
deviations.detail: AgentRag: kiến thức, sự kiện, hướng dẫn được embed bằng bge-m3 vào collection nso_agent_memory; LLM chỉ nhận 8 trí nhớ liên quan + 8 sự kiện mới nhất; quá ngữ cảnh thì LLM tóm tắt sự kiện cũ.

deviations.title: Lưới địa hình và trí nhớ NPC cho LLM
deviations.detail: Prompt có lưới toàn map (_ tới được, x không tới được, # đặc, w gỗ/đá, . không khí) và vị trí NPC của các map đã đi qua (npcs:<map>).

deviations.title: LLM thấy bản đồ có tọa độ
deviations.detail: AgentMapView: vị trí bản thân, lối ra, NPC, quái, vật phẩm, người chơi; bước goto {map,x,y}; LLM can thiệp sau 90 giây không có kết quả (LlmStallSeconds).

deviations.title: RL điều khiển mặc định
deviations.detail: RlSettings: Mode RL, Guidance 0, Stage 3; rule chỉ là dự phòng khi chưa có model đạt kiểm tra.

deviations.title: LLM dẫn dắt người chơi AI
deviations.detail: AgentConfig.LlmLeads: kế hoạch LLM (đã kiểm tra) được thực hiện; rules/RL chỉ chạy tạm khi LLM đang nghĩ hoặc lỗi.

deviations.title: Tìm đường cho người chơi AI
deviations.detail: BotNavigation: đồ thị theo ô 24 px, cạnh là khung hình client mô phỏng (đi, nhảy, nhảy đôi, rơi). Mục tiêu không tới được thì bỏ qua 20 giây.

deviations.title: Headless client locomotion executor
deviations.notes: Offline addition to the original Java server: emulate base Char.updateCharRun/updateCharJump/updateCharFall/setAutoJump client geometry for bots. Conservative solid-body sweeps. No server bot privilege or direct coordinate write. Separate client-frame loop leaves 500 ms world/AI clocks unchanged. Runtime and special mount/flight parity remain unverified.

deviations.title: Training reward shaping for item/NPC use
deviations.notes: User-requested offline RL metadata only; no Java counterpart and no human/bot gameplay privilege. Controller observes before/after outcomes. Same classification for opted-in human demonstrations; bot novelty stored in ai_players.rewardHistory, opted-in human novelty in rl_reward_history_<characterId>. Optional fields preserve old saves.

deviations.title: Same pickup rules for humans and bots
deviations.notes: User explicitly requires no bot exceptions. Java ItemMap.isCanPickup=20 s and isExpired=30 s are superseded by shared configurable 30 s protection and 60 s lifetime, leaving a usable public pickup window. Original other-owner text retained. AI courtesy reservations influence decisions only and never block a human pickup/attack; NPC/zone/bag/range checks remain normal Controller rules.

deviations.title: Offline learning AI players
deviations.notes: User-approved RL extension, no Java counterpart: rules demonstrations and opt-in player input train behavioural cloning; version-matched policy transitions train maintained MaskablePPO. BotClient/Controller remain authoritative. LLM provides advice/speech. No save schema change or free stat/recovery privileges.

deviations.title: Người chơi AI
deviations.detail: Bổ sung offline: nhân vật AI đăng nhập bằng bot session, gửi đúng lệnh client; không dùng được dev terminal.

deviations.title: Nhìn thấy nhân vật khác trong khu
deviations.detail: Bản offline gửi PLAYER_ADD/MOVE/REMOVE/DIE giữa các nhân vật cùng khu (Net/Presence) cho người chơi AI.

deviations.title: SQLite instead of MySQL / TSV
deviations.detail: Java used MySQL; offline saves were TSV files, now SQLite nso.db (same columns, data JSON unchanged). Player log in its own SQLite file.

deviations.title: CHAT_MAP server→client shows a bubble again
deviations.detail: MapService.chat (int id, UTF text). The offline client ignored it; restored for the agents' speech.

deviations.title: Autonomous NPC ninjas (hybrid AI)
deviations.detail: Offline addition: server-side fake characters driven by a local LLM (strategy) and game AI (tactics). Java only had scripted Bot instances.

deviations.title: Animation skill chạy theo tick logic, không theo FPS
deviations.why: Client gốc vẽ 1 lần mỗi tick và tăng frame skill trong lúc vẽ; Unity vẽ 60-144 fps nên skill chạy nhanh gấp 3-6 lần.
deviations.how: Char.paintCharWithSkill chỉ tăng indexSkill/i0-i2/tạo mũi tên ở lần vẽ đầu sau mỗi tick (Main.LogicTick); các lần vẽ sau vẽ lại cùng frame.

deviations.title: Menu Tajima: bỏ 'nhận lời mời' và 'Thứ thân', kiếm gỗ chỉ nhận một lần
deviations.why: Offline không có người chơi khác (lời mời) và không có phân thân; 'Nhận kiếm gỗ' (thêm offline) trước đây nhận vô hạn.
deviations.how: PlayerTasks.NpcTajima: 'Hủy vật phẩm và nhiệm vụ' (Char.clearTask, cần cấp 10), 'Nói chuyện', 'Nhận kiếm gỗ' chỉ khi chưa có kiếm gỗ trong hành trang/rương/trang bị.

deviations.title: Counted supply stacks and bag/chest split command
deviations.why: User clarified actual one-cell stacks with quantities, excluding equipment, and requested quantity splitting.
deviations.notes: Extends original stack eligibility for supplies on explicit Sort. NOT_MAP -85 split request/ack extended with container flag; clone metadata and preserve quantities. Expiring instances not merged. Legacy crafting remains unit-based: split materials first.

deviations.title: Group inventory by type on explicit Sort
deviations.why: User requested same-type grouping in bag and box only when pressing Sort.
deviations.notes: Shared pure ordering policy for client/server; existing bagSort/boxSort merging and ack protocol retained. Type, id, lock and original index determine deterministic order. No automatic reordering.

deviations.title: School-specific elemental catalogs
deviations.why: User requested NPCs at each school sell that school element only.
deviations.notes: Filters existing Char.requestItem/Store.show/Store.buy catalog consistently; no item-table rewrite. Neutral supplies retained, classed skill books filtered by element. Other maps unchanged.

deviations.title: Enabled item is the exception to manual ground pickup
deviations.why: User explicitly requested Thien bien lenh auto-pick after reporting it inactive.
deviations.notes: Existing item automation/protocol completed; no global suction. While item and persistent auto active, normal nearby pickup requests run. Off/pause stops requests. Range origin, server expiry/item validation and cooldown constrain auto movement.

deviations.title: Manual ground-loot interaction in ordinary play
deviations.why: User clarified they do not want automatic suction or pickup.
deviations.notes: Supersedes nearby-auto-pickup: no Char.update auto collector or GameScr.update suction invocation. Ground items/yen use explicit interaction and normal server checks. Separately invoked legacy auto-play/task routines are outside this change.

deviations.title: Nearby all-item auto pickup without auto-play
deviations.why: User reported no automatic pickup and requested yen on the ground.
deviations.notes: Reuses Char.autoPickItemMap and normal server validation; configurable 120px/350ms defaults, no movement. Yen ground drops match Mob.dropItem(YEN), pickup packet is sole client credit; server rewards still use AddYen normally.

deviations.title: Dev terminal teleport to main quest objective
deviations.why: User requested /goto to travel to the next needed main-quest location.
deviations.notes: QuestTravel resolves existing task map/NPC/spawns; normal map travel bypasses walking/unlock routing. Quest advancement remains in existing hooks; no direct TaskNext or reward grant. Private-instance entry rules retained.

deviations.title: Harder monster combat default profile
deviations.why: User requested stronger monsters and reduced player dodge after equipment recovery was identified.
deviations.notes: CombatRules defaults 50/100/40/150 for dodge scale/monster accuracy/dodge cap/damage. No raw character stats or save changes. Web tunables and explicit saved overrides retained.

deviations.title: Use actual damage in monster-hit packets; stat refresh does not heal
deviations.why: User still saw full HP recovery on hits and reported monsters too weak.
deviations.notes: Supersedes raw-display/scaled-deduction Java Mob.attack behavior: scale once before packets; post-hit observer HP; no duplicate victim observer hit. Client ME_LOAD_SKILL/UPDATE_POTENTIAL clamp HP/MP rather than fill them. Default damage factor 100% by request; web/saved overrides remain supported.

deviations.title: Reject negative injury deltas as healing
deviations.why: User reported HP rising without items; -1 MISS from Java Mob.attack display protocol was subtracted as damage.
deviations.notes: Client Char.doInjure subtracts HPShow/MPShow only if positive. Original signed values retained for MISS display. Food/potions/equipment recovery paths unchanged.

deviations.title: Dev terminal /next bypasses one quest step
deviations.why: User requested advancing to the next quest step and hiding the map Go To button.
deviations.notes: NextTaskStep validates active quest/index, then reuses Char.taskNext port. It does not finish or accept quests; /skip retains completion. Map left command null; legacy travel handler remains unbound.

deviations.title: Controller map toggle and analog cursor
deviations.why: User requested Share/Create to open and close the map and left stick to move its cursor.
deviations.notes: MapScr.updateKey extended with render-cadence cursor movement; analog selection never invokes legacy adminMove. Existing Go To and close commands retained; speed configurable in NsoGamepadInput.

deviations.title: Offline gamepad Share/Create map shortcut
deviations.why: Explicit user request for Share to open the map.
deviations.notes: Reuses GameScr.doShowMap via action 110002; no gameplay or map rendering changes.

deviations.title: Shared non-wrapping item-grid focus
deviations.why: User requested child cells return to tabs consistently like inventory, including upgrade, equipment, mount, chest and bijuu.
deviations.notes: Pure TabGridNavigation shared via GameScr adapters; left/right boundary -> title, Up -> parent. Equipment vertical shape preserved; upgrade hierarchy explicit. Original action/confirmation/gameplay handlers unchanged.

deviations.title: Equipment upgrade keyboard/gamepad navigation
deviations.why: Large-screen upgrade has no centre select command; tooltip captured directional keys and equipment row could not return to tabs.
deviations.notes: Scoped to isPaintUpGrade: Enter invokes left action, directions navigate slots, Up returns to title. Existing validation/confirmation/cost/probability preserved.

deviations.title: Remove MapScr local-map mode and Change command
deviations.why: Explicit user request: unnecessary third button and its features removed.
deviations.notes: Original MapScr 1001/local-map paint/bounds removed. World map, Go To and Close retained. Command hitboxes follow image size and actual bottom-row position; map gestures exclude this row.

deviations.title: Wide popup commands follow panel bounds
deviations.why: GameScr.paint fixed -160/-35/+88 offsets disagree with the 310-pixel panel and actual button width.
deviations.notes: Presentation only: configurable inset -2 matches paintFrame outer border. Narrow layouts, command actions and vertical row unchanged.

deviations.title: Configurable native character progression
deviations.why: User requested intuitive base/growth controls without replacing class mechanics.
deviations.how: Optional base/growthPercent/growthFlat profiles augment native curves; classed allocated points remain separate. Empty profiles keep original behavior. Balance v2 accepts v1; previews do not save or publish.

deviations.title: Global game balancing
deviations.why: User clarified durable whole-game tuning, not a current-character/session editor.
deviations.how: #dashboard writes game-balance.json (player/potential percent + flat, future EXP gain, global/template effective equipment options) and monster-tuning.json. Existing and future objects use these rules without rewriting raw player allocations/item options. Protected API, explicit save/reset, read-only previews and normal protocol refresh. Compile-only validation; user handles runtime debugging.

deviations.title: Dark workbench and larger typography
deviations.why: User requested dark mode, larger and heavier text, and Apple fonts.
deviations.how: Dark default, one Apple-first system UI font stack with Segoe UI fallback across all text including code/JSON/IDs, 15-17px reading text. No font downloads or external services; browser QA left to user.

deviations.title: Mouse wheel units
deviations.why: Input System normalized notches were divided by 120 again, rounding scrolling to zero.
deviations.how: Bridge honors scrollDeltaBehavior; divide only native Windows units by 120. Existing WheelStepPx remains 24; user verifies hardware scrolling.

deviations.title: Render-rate notification text
deviations.why: User reported stepped scrolling MP-full text.
deviations.how: Info/InfoMe interpolate text placement under Smooth Effects; preserve original timing and fixed clipping. Final revision compile-only verified; user handles visual debugging.

deviations.title: Fractional world and list-content painting
deviations.notes: Original client paints integer positions at low logic rate. Extend existing Interp snapshots and scoped GUI transforms across world renderers; nested projectiles replace parent residuals. Scroll hit-testing and logic offsets remain unchanged; viewport/origin/paint cleanup restores transforms. Map transitions/teleports snap. No sprite frame synthesis or gameplay timing change.

deviations.title: Release manual ground movement without friction delay
deviations.notes: Original client Char.updateCharRun decreases cvx by one per tick: observed 9 ticks/0.375 s and 36 extra pixels at speed 8. Keyboard arrow/number-pad and pointer movement release now request an immediate stop; configurable in Inspector. Movement speed, airborne motion and destination paths unchanged.

deviations.title: Persistent configurable offline loot gates
deviations.notes: User requested web settings. Per-world immutable validated policy replaces active hardcoded gates; defaults retain prior behavior and Java probabilities. No player/static/reference file writes.

deviations.title: Render-time effect interpolation and popup/HP transitions
deviations.notes: Original client GameScr updateFlyText/updateSplash, Menu updateMenu, Mob paint remain logic-owned. Fractional painting adds intermediate positions and visual HP easing; recently reopened menus get a minimum opening instead of snapping. Server damage and effect lifetimes unchanged.

deviations.title: All loot blocked at 10-level overlevel gap
deviations.notes: User decision 2026-11-11: block quest items, ordinary items/currency and sushi at >=10 levels below player. Dummy exclusion matches Java and also covers sushi. Original ordinary-loot seven-level gate remains.

deviations.title: Unity render/logic skill timing
deviations.notes: Original client Char.updateSkillPaint/setAttack uses exact hit-frame equality. Offline Unity timing uses >= with one dispatch per cast before cleanup because rendering can skip the exact frame between logic ticks. Damage/range/cooldown unchanged.

deviations.title: Unsourced natural recovery disabled
deviations.why: User corrected the prior free-recovery behavior. Java requires effects or equipment.
deviations.how: NaturalRegenPercent defaults to 0; old positive branch is opt-in only. Food/potion/equipment remain unchanged.

deviations.title: Bỏ qua bước nhiệm vụ chưa port
deviations.why: Hang động, câu cá, xách nước, hằng ngày, bạn bè, nâng cấp, chiến trường chưa có.
deviations.how: Menu 'Bỏ qua: <bước>' ở NPC giao nhiệm vụ.

deviations.title: Hộ tống Jaian: thông báo thất bại, chữ vàng
deviations.why: Java im lặng khi hộ tống thất bại; người chơi muốn dòng 'do <tên> hộ tống' màu vàng.
deviations.how: Gửi SUB_COMMAND -90 (PROTECT_FAR / PROTECT_INJURE của client). Quái đánh Jaian như Java (MobBrain). Char.cs vẽ dòng hộ tống bằng tahoma_7_yellow. Net/Escort.cs.

deviations.title: Không chết khi đứng trên mặt đất ở hàng ô cuối map
deviations.why: Map 61, 63 có hàng ô cuối là mặt đất; luật Java cy >= pxh - 24 giết người đang đi trên đó.
deviations.how: PlayerActions.IsCrossMap bỏ qua luật đáy map khi ô dưới chân là T_TOP.

deviations.title: Chuyển map không thành: gửi RESET_POINT
deviations.why: Java im lặng khi không tìm thấy waypoint ở vị trí server; client đã khóa màn hình đen (ischangingMap) nên đen mãi.
deviations.how: PlayerActions.RequestChangeMap / ChangeMap gửi RESET_POINT ở mọi nhánh không chuyển map, client mở khóa và đi tiếp sẽ chuyển lại.

deviations.title: Bước 'nói chuyện' ở NPC chưa port menu

deviations.title: Chiêu cơ bản tự tăng cấp khi chưa vào trường
deviations.why: User request (2026-11-12); the data has one row for skill template 0.
deviations.how: Class 0 gets one automatic point of skill template 0 per level (max BasicSkillGrowth.MaxPoint = 9), each point -CooldownStepMs (20) cooldown. Rows ids 30001..30009 are generated on client (Controller.AddBasicSkillGrowth) and server (GameWorld.AddBasicSkillGrowth); PlayerCombat.SyncBasicSkill applies it on enter and level-up.

deviations.title: Khung chat là terminal lệnh dev
deviations.why: User request (2026-11-12).
deviations.how: The original chat icon opens ChatTextField; The terminal is the original message window (alert popup, message-style title) with the chat input line under it. /command lines go as CHAT_MAP (-23) to Server/Net/DevTerminal.cs (/help, /skip = finish the current quest via PlayerTasks.SkipTask; /lv = +1 level, /tolv n = up to level n (0..150) via PlayerCombat.AddExp; /clear is client-side); lines without / are local public chat (bubble over the player) and replies with SERVER_MESSAGE (-24) prefixed by char 7, shown in the window. No public chat offline.

deviations.title: NV Thách đấu (quest 13) gym fight
deviations.detail: Net/Gymnasium.cs ports Gymnasium + Bot/AttackAround/MoveWithinCustom. Offline deviations: 'Vào phòng thi đấu' only on the matching headmaster's step (1 Ookamesama, 2 Kazeto, 3 Toyotomi; Java offered it on any step and advanced on any win); bot skill range fixed at dx/dy + 100 (Java added 100 per tick); HAVE_ATTACK_PLAYER carries the HP after the hit; PvP (PLAYER_ATTACK_PLAYER 61) is accepted only against the gym bot.
